FAQ / Quick answers

Before we get started.

Can I order a game from scratch?

Yes. We can take an initial idea through prototyping, design, development, and delivery of a release-ready build.

Can I order just a prototype?

Yes. We can build a playable version of the core mechanic so you can test the idea before full development.

How much does development cost?

It depends on the scope, platforms, content, and timeline. Tell us about your project and we’ll discuss what it would take to build.
